request.system: Assess whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests numbered claims. Return JSON only: {"uses_claim": true|false, "claim_ids": []}. Return one bare JSON object without Markdown fences or commentary. uses_claim must be a JSON boolean. claim_ids must be an array of integer claim numbers, never quoted strings; use an empty array when uses_claim is false.
request.prompt: {"claims": {"1": "**Findings so far**", "2": "Two temporal signals failed.", "3": "Ranking groups by acceleration in average hours, lagged one month, gave a mean information coefficient near 0.02 and a HAC t-statistic near 0.7, well below two.", "4": "Its ranks also turned over quickly.", "5": "Ranking groups by how persistently the stock rate variable rose over six lagged months did worse, with coefficient near 0.01 and t-statistic near 0.5, despite stable ranks.", "6": "Both looked somewhat stronger when the common index was high.", "7": "Conditioning on high-index regimes merits testing, though that split may be noise.", "8": "Coverage was about 95 percent, and overlap with base factors stayed low."}, "hypothesis": "Groups combining strong year-over-year hourly pay growth with stock rate V06 below its own 60-month norm, relative to peers, reflect tightening demand-driven conditions, predicting higher relative returns next month.", "expression": "spread(yoy(V05),tsz(V06,60))"}
